question: When are mutually identified forms worshipped in such a Shiva state?
premises: This occurs in such a Shiva state.
It occurs when nyasa of prana-support is fashioned by intellect.
inference: Intellectually fashioned prana-support nyasa enables worship of mutually identified forms in a Shiva state.
uncertainties: nayāse may be a variant form of nyāsa.
plain_english: Worship those who have become mutually identified, in such a Shiva state, when nyasa of prana-support is fashioned by intellect.
